'''2011 Bespin Regionals Brian Herold LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Max Rebo, You Have A Great Ear for Jizz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
